text_block_list.text:
After school. While visiting the training 
track partly to check in on the other 
horse girls...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ――Dammiiiiiiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... Have you finally learned to give 
up today, Ama-san?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! As if I ever would!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Hishi Amazon" is a sore loser who never 
quits!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you beat me down, 
until the day I devour you, I won't let 
you take this life...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph. You never change.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You said the exact same thing in the past.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*...! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, hold on! This match isn't over 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It makes no difference how many times 
we run. You cannot defeat me. Just as in 
the past, so it will be in the future.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ... You're just like a lion in a zoo.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Am I wrong? Turning your back before 
you've even finished off your prey.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You don't even believe for a fraction of a 
second that you're part of the law of the 
jungle. Looking so bored, just endlessly 
starved.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. ――I'll make you 
remember soon enough!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The sheer terror of being the one who gets 
devoured. And the thrill of a race where 
your life is on the line!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Hishi Amazon" is a sore loser who never 
gives up. No matter how many times you 
beat me down――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Until I sink my fangs into you, I won't 
let you take this life!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What is it? If you've got something to 
say, say it loud and... hey, wait!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will devour you. Prepare 
yourself――Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah~. Was that so? Well, if you say so, it 
must be true.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Though I remember your whole solitary 
lion attitude pretty darn well. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch. ――And when exactly are you going to 
sink your fangs into me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha?! You're asking for it, aren't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! ――Then let's go for another 
round, one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just as you wish, this time I'm definitely 
gonna devour you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but I will be the one devouring 
you today!

The two ran as if striving to devour one 
another. In their silhouettes, I felt an 
unshakeable bond.
